#F7P1 plots and stats to accompany ISH of Wnt targets and Wnt3a in lakritz mutants
```{r}
#load file and check
Wntinsitulak <-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/TectumF6P1_Wntinsitu_lak.csv")
View(Wntinsitulak)
```
### F7P1 Plot
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#specify levels for ISH gene and genotype
Wntinsitulak$Gene<-factor(Wntinsitulak$Gene,
                         levels=c("axin2", "lef1"))
Wntinsitulak$Genotype<-factor(Wntinsitulak$Genotype,
                         levels=c("WT", "lak"))
```
#Make box plot
```{r, echo=FALSE}
TectumF6P1_Wntinsitu_lak <- ggplot(Wntinsitulak, aes(x=Genotype, y=Area))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~Gene, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x", nrow=1)+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))+
  xlab("Genotype")+
  ylab(bquote('Total area gene expression '(µm^2)))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=expression(WT, italic(lak)))+
  ylim(2e+09, 5.7e+09)+
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("WT", "lak")), 
    method="t.test",
    label = "p.signif")

print(TectumF6P1_Wntinsitu_lak)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave ("TectumF6P1_Wntinsitu_lak.png", TectumF6P1_Wntinsitu_lak, path=NULL, 
        scale = 1, width = 12, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

#Summary stats for area stained by axin2 and lef1 in lak and sibs
```{r}
#Summary Statistics (n, mean, SD)
group_by(Wntinsitulak, Genotype, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean = mean(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Area, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Specify axin2
A <- Wntinsitulak$Gene == "axin2"
Wntinsitulak[A,]
#Specify lef1
Wntinsitulak[!A,]
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Before t-test, you have to (1) check for normal distribution and (2) check for equal variance
# Check for normal distribution
with(Wntinsitulak[A,], shapiro.test(Area[Genotype == "lak"])) #p-value = 0.2694
with(Wntinsitulak[A,], shapiro.test(Area[Genotype == "WT"])) #p-value = 0.9714
with(Wntinsitulak[!A,], shapiro.test(Area[Genotype == "lak"])) #p-value = 0.9986
with(Wntinsitulak[!A,], shapiro.test(Area[Genotype == "WT"])) #p-value = 0.4918
#p-value > 0.05 implies that the distribution of the data are not significantly different from normal distribution.
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(Wntinsitulak[A,]$Area, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(Wntinsitulak[A,]$Area, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(Wntinsitulak[!A,]$Area, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(Wntinsitulak[!A,]$Area, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Variance Testing
#We will be using Welch's t-test which assumes unequal variance!
var.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[A,]) #p-value = 0.4353
var.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[!A,]) #p-value = 0.9166
#p-value > 0.05 implies that the variances are not significantly different from each other
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# T-Test for comparing 2 variables; data is normally distributed and dataset is sparse; Welch's t.test is recommended. 

# axin
t.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[A,])
wilcox.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[A,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)

# lef1
t.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[!A,])
wilcox.test(Area ~ Genotype, data = Wntinsitulak[!A,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)

```

#F7P2: Wnt3a ISH stats quantitation in lak and sibs across ages
```{r}
Wnt3a_quant <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/LakAge_wnt3a_Yehyun_thesis.csv")
view(Wnt3a_quant)

#need to summarise data (n per condition; mean per condition; standard error/standard deviation)
group_by(Wnt3a_quant, Genotype, Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count= n(),
    median = median(wnt3a_volumeE3, na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean = mean(wnt3a_volumeE3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(wnt3a_volumeE3, na.rm = TRUE))

#order variables by genotype and age:
Wnt3a_quant$Genotype <-factor(Wnt3a_quant$Genotype, levels=c("WT", "lak"))
Wnt3a_quant$Age <-factor(Wnt3a_quant$Age, levels=c("5", "7", "9"))
```
#Wnt3a ISH stats
```{r}
#run stats Yehyun's way
stats_Wnt3a <-aov(wnt3a_volumeE3 ~Genotype+ Age +Genotype:Age, data = Wnt3a_quant)
summary(stats_Wnt3a)

TukeyHSD(stats_Wnt3a, which = "Genotype:Age")
```
# but worried about whether the volumes and age are really interacting with each other since it seems like lak is always 2x less than wt; also there is some heteroscedasticity; the DAPI staining wasn't quantified/wasn't uniform enough to make a ratio so ask Claude and Gemini approaches to deal with this since we measured volume and not counts or a ratio that ranges from +/- 1 --> log transform then ANOVA then back transform to keep the tails from having too much weight
```{r}
#log transform the volume data to help
Wnt3a_quant$Age <- factor(Wnt3a_quant$Age)
modelWnt3a <- lm(log(wnt3a_volume) ~ Genotype * Age, data = Wnt3a_quant)

shapiro.test(resid(modelWnt3a)); car::leveneTest(log(wnt3a_volume) ~ Genotype * Age, data = Wnt3a_quant)
car::Anova(modelWnt3a, type = 2)

summary(modelWnt3a)

emm <- emmeans(modelWnt3a, ~ Genotype | Age)
# back-transformed fold-change, lak vs WT, at each age
summary(contrast(emm, "revpairwise", by = "Age"), adjust = "holm", by = NULL, type = "response")

#to show changes in ages for lak across ages and WT across ages
m <- lm(log(wnt3a_volume) ~ Genotype * Age, data = Wnt3a_quant)

emm_age <- emmeans(m, ~ Age | Genotype)
summary(pairs(emm_age), adjust = "holm", type = "response")   # fold-changes, both genotypes

```

##Plot changes in Wnt3a volume across genotypes by age
```{r}
#load/reload data
Wnt3a_quant <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures 6_7_Wnt tectum figure images/LakAge_wnt3a_Yehyun_thesis.csv")
view(Wnt3a_quant)

#factor data so each level is visible
Wnt3a_quant$Genotype <-factor(Wnt3a_quant$Genotype, levels=c("WT", "lak"))
Wnt3a_quant$Age <-factor(Wnt3a_quant$Age, levels=c("5", "7", "9"))

#want to rename age to include dpf
Wnt3a_quant <- Wnt3a_quant %>% 
 mutate(Age = case_when(
  Age == "5" ~ "5_dpf",
  Age == "7" ~ "7_dpf",
  Age == "9" ~ "9_dpf", TRUE       ~ as.character(Age)),
  Age = factor(Age, levels = c("5_dpf", "7_dpf", "9_dpf"))) # Re-factor here!
 
view(Wnt3a_quant)

```

```{r}
#want to make table for manual p-values from ANOVA post-hoc
stat_manual_wnt3a <-tibble::tribble(
  ~Age, ~group1,~group2,~p.adj,
  "5_dpf", "WT", "lak", 0.0001,
  "7_dpf", "WT", "lak", 0.0001,
  "9_dpf","WT","lak", 0.0001
) %>%
  mutate(
    Age = factor(Age, levels = c("5_dpf", "7_dpf", "9_dpf")),
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    y.position = 190   # adjust based on your beeswarm/error bar heights per facet
  )
```

```{r}
my_comparisons <- list(c("WT", "lak"))

plot_wnt3a <- ggplot(Wnt3a_quant) +
  aes(x = Genotype, y = wnt3a_volumeE3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.8, width=0.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~Age, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x", nrow=1)+
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.x = element_text())+
  xlab("Genotype")+
  (ylab(bquote('wnt3a volume x1000 ' (µm^3))))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)))+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"))+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size = 16))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_manual_wnt3a, label = "p.adj.signif", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position")
plot_wnt3a

```

```{r}
ggsave ("plot_Wnt3a.png", plot_wnt3a, scale = 1, width = 12, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

###qPCR of Wnt3a and other Wnt targets (axin2 and sox2)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWnt3a <-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/Fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/qPCR_2023/qPCR_wnt_targets_ALL_2023_forR.csv")
View(qPCRWnt3a)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWnt3aSummary <- summarySE(qPCRWnt3a, measurevar="Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level", groupvars=c("Gene","Genotype"))
qPCRWnt3aSummary
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
qPCRWnt3a$Gene<-factor(qPCRWnt3a$Gene,
                        levels=c("wnt3a", "axin2", "sox2"))

qPCRWnt3a$Genotype<-factor(qPCRWnt3a$Genotype,
                       levels=c("WT", "lak"))

qPCRWnt3aSummary$Gene<-factor(qPCRWnt3aSummary$Gene,
                        levels=c("wnt3a", "axin2", "sox2"))

qPCRWnt3aSummary$Genotype<-factor(qPCRWnt3aSummary$Genotype,
                       levels=c("WT", "lak"))

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
TectumF7P3_Wnt3aqPCR<- ggplot(qPCRWnt3aSummary, aes(x= Genotype, y= Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", aes(fill=Genotype), show.legend=FALSE)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("dark gray", "light gray"))+
  facet_wrap(~Gene, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x")+
  xlab("Genotype")+
  ylab("Mean Relative Expression")+ 
  geom_errorbar(data=qPCRWnt3aSummary, 
                aes(ymin=Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level-ci,
                    ymax=Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level+ci, width=.15))+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))+
  ylim(0, 1.52)+
  stat_compare_means(data=qPCRWnt3a,comparisons = list(c("WT", "lak")), method="t.test", label = "p.signif")

print(TectumF7P3_Wnt3aqPCR)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave ("TectumF7P3_Wnt3aqPCR.png", TectumF7P3_Wnt3aqPCR, path=NULL, 
        scale = 1, width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```
### Part 3 Statistics
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Summary Statistics (n, mean, SD)
group_by(qPCRWnt3a, Genotype, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean = mean(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Specify axin2
W <- qPCRWnt3a$Gene == "wnt3a"
qPCRWnt3a[W,]
#Specify lef1
A <- qPCRWnt3a$Gene == "axin2"
qPCRWnt3a[A,]
#Specify ccnD1
S <- qPCRWnt3a$Gene == "sox2"
qPCRWnt3a[S,]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Before t-test, you have to (1) check for normal distribution and (2) check for equal variance
# Check for normal distribution
with(qPCRWnt3a[W,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "WT"])) 
with(qPCRWnt3a[W,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "lak"]))  
with(qPCRWnt3a[A,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "WT"])) 
with(qPCRWnt3a[A,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "lak"])) 
with(qPCRWnt3a[S,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "WT"])) 
with(qPCRWnt3a[S,], shapiro.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level[Genotype == "lak"])) 

#p-value > 0.05 implies that the distribution of the data are not significantly different from normal distribution.
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt3a[A,]$Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)
qqline(qPCRWnt3a[A,]$Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt3a[L,]$Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
qqnorm(qPCRWnt3a[C,]$Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level, pch = 1, frame = FALSE)

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Variance Testing
var.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level ~ Genotype, data = qPCRWnt3a[W,]) 
var.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level ~ Genotype, data = qPCRWnt3a[A,])  
var.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level ~ Genotype, data = qPCRWnt3a[S,]) 
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# stat tests comparing 2 variables (welch's t.test = oneway.test, which is default for t.test)
# data is normally distributed, so use t-test

# wnt3a
t.test (Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level ~ Genotype, data = qPCRWnt3a[W,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) #p=0.02323

# axin2
t.test(Relative_Normalized_Expression_Level ~ Genotype, data = qPCRWnt3a[A,], exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) #p=0.001423

# sox2
```
